Agentik daemon for macOS

Version: @VERSION@

  • agentik-darwin-arm64 - Apple Silicon (M1 and later)
  • agentik-darwin-amd64 - Intel
  • SHA256SUMS - checksums
  • README.txt - how to verify and run

Run uname -m to check: arm64 is Apple Silicon, x86_64 is Intel.

After downloading

A downloaded file is not executable yet, whichever way you got it. In Terminal, in the folder you downloaded to:

chmod +x agentik-darwin-arm64
./agentik-darwin-arm64

If you downloaded in a browser, macOS may also refuse the first run. Allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security, or clear the quarantine flag:

xattr -d com.apple.quarantine agentik-darwin-arm64

Downloading with curl avoids that prompt altogether:

curl -fLO https://sergey-telpuk.github.io/agentik/downloads/agentik-darwin-arm64
chmod +x agentik-darwin-arm64
./agentik-darwin-arm64
